A second-order class in Wikidata, e.g., watercraft type (Q16335899),  bridge by structural type (Q17644823),  or first-order class (Q104086571), is a class all of whose instances are implicitly or explicitly an instance of (P31) first-order class (Q104086571).  A class is implicitly a second-order classes if it is a subclass of (P279) another class that is a second-order class, e.g.,  submarine type (Q121289744) is implicitly a second order class because it is a subclass of (P279) watercraft type (Q16335899).  These implicit instance of instance of (P31) statements are not all observable in Wikidata.  Before stating that a class is an instance of (P31) second-order class (Q24017414) check that it is actually a second-order class, i.e., that all its instances are classes of individuals.
